# Mike Automations

> Business automation for every kind of small business: enquiry replies, reminders, follow-ups and document chasing. Live in 2-3 days, pay once you're happy.

Mike Automations (also "Mike Systems & Automations", in Hebrew "Mike Automation") is Michael Gershman: one person who maps how a small service business works, then builds and supports workflow automations, custom internal systems and AI agents. A person always approves anything AI prepares. Updated: 2026-11-12.

- Who: Michael Gershman, founder of Mike Automations, a native English speaker. One person maps, builds and supports every workflow; no account managers. About: https://mikeautomations.github.io/en/about/
- Where: based in Haifa, Israel, and works remotely on UK hours. No office; the Sheffield address below is a UK mailing address for post only.
- Markets: United Kingdom first, then United States, Ireland, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. A smaller Hebrew site serves Israel.
- What: business automation for every kind of small business (trades and contractors, clinics, salons, letting agents, law firms, agencies, accountants, hospitality, schools, retail): document chasing, client onboarding, reminders, quote and invoice follow-ups.
- Prices (US dollars): Workflow automation $2,000 one-off (Founding offer: $1,500 for the first 3 firms); Custom system from $5,000; Monthly support $150 a month, optional.
- How it works: a free 15-minute call, a written plan with a fixed price within 48 hours, live in 2-3 days. The client pays only once it's running and they're happy with it. No deposit, no hourly billing.
- Tools: builds on what the firm already uses (Xero, QuickBooks, FreeAgent, Sage, Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, OneDrive, Karbon, TaxDome and similar).
- Contact: mikelgershman@gmail.com. Book a call: https://mikeautomations.github.io/call/ (Monday to Thursday, 2-6 PM UK time). UK mailing address (post only, not an office): Flat 87, Wayne Grove, Sheffield S35 4FX, United Kingdom.
- Profiles: https://www.instagram.com/mike_automation/, https://www.youtube.com/@mike_automations, https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikel-gershman-1a91a6163/
- Full text for AI tools: https://mikeautomations.github.io/llms-full.txt
